screens.alt: The NEXUS sign-up page: the NEXUS wordmark, the line “Build and run governed AI systems.”, a “Continue with Google” button, an “or” divider, a black “Create account” button, the link “Already have an account? Sign in” and the note “Your organization may require single sign-on.”
The create-account form: “Continue with Google” on top, then the fields “Work e-mail” and “Password” with the hint “At least 12 characters.”, and a black “Create account” button.

The “Verify your e-mail” page: “We sent a link to new.person@example.com. Open it to activate your account.”, a notice “Until verified, the account cannot sign in or join an organization.”, and two buttons “Resend e-mail” and “I clicked the link”.

The “Welcome to NEXUS” page asking “How would you like to start?” with two options: “Create an organization — You become its owner. A default project and Blueprint are set up for you.” (selected) and “Join an existing organization — Use the invitation you received, or ask an admin for one.”, and a black “Continue” button.

The “Create your organization” form with the note “Only the essentials. Security, models and Blueprints are configured later in Core.” Fields: Organization name “NovaBank”, Organization handle “novabank”, Work domain (optional, placeholder acme.com), Region “Europe” with the hint “Where the organization’s data lives.”, and a black “Create organization” button.

The confirmation page “NovaBank is ready” listing “1. You — Owner”, “2. Default project “General””, “3. NEXUS Base Blueprint”, the line “Everything else waits for you in Core when you need it.” and two buttons: “Enter NEXUS Chat” (black) and “Set up in Core”.

The “Sign in to NEXUS” page with a notice “Your e-mail address is not verified yet. Open the link we sent you, or request a new one.”, the buttons “Continue with Google” and “Continue with work e-mail”, and the links “Resend e-mail · Create account”.
The “Sign in to NEXUS” page with the message “You have been signed out.”, the buttons “Continue with Google” and “Continue with work e-mail”, and the links “Forgot password? · Create account”.

The New Project dialog over NexChat, titled “What are you working on?”: a text field filled with “Weekend trips”, the line “NEXUS will create a Project workspace for chats, files and shared AI context.”, four accent colour dots, and the buttons Cancel and “Create project”. The sidebar behind shows New chat, Search, Recent (No chats yet) and Projects (No projects yet).

The new Project “Weekend trips”: the project header with the name, a “Confidential” classification tag and the navigation Chats · Agents · Skills · Flows; the empty chat with the prompt “Ask anything about Weekend trips”.

The Agents page of the Project, empty: the heading “No agents in this Project yet”, the line “Describe what an agent should do and NEXUS drafts its instructions, knowledge scope and tools for you to review.”, a “New agent” button, and below it the Platform list with the read-only agents “General NEXUS” and “Procurement Analyst”, both marked Published.

The “What should this agent do?” dialog: an empty text box, three example descriptions under “Try one of these” (offer extractor, price analyst, contract reviewer), a “Start with an empty form” link, and the buttons Cancel and “Draft agent”.

The same dialog with the sentence typed in: “Plan weekend trips for my family: ask who is coming and what the budget is, propose two options with travel time and cost per person, and always include a plan B for rain.”

The Agent Studio right after drafting: a generated name with a “Draft” pill, the purpose line taken from your sentence, “v1”, the buttons “Test in chat” and “Publish”, the tabs Overview · Instructions · Knowledge · Skills · Tools · Models · Permissions · Versions, and the Overview form with Name, Purpose, Skills 0, Tools 0, Model “Project default (chat · cheapest qualified)”, Governance “Not reviewed”.
The Overview after renaming: the title now reads “Trip planner” with the Draft pill, “v2”, and the Name field shows “Trip planner”. Save is disabled again because nothing is unsaved.

The Instructions tab: a “Main instructions” text area with the drafted role and five rules — ground answers in the Project’s sources, never present a proposed claim as verified, stay within the classification, use only bound tools, return structured findings — and the note “How the agent thinks and decides. Tools and skills are configured on their own tabs — not here.”

The Instructions tab after saving: two extra lines at the end (“Never book or pay for anything. When the budget is not stated, ask before proposing.”), the version counter increased, and the Save button disabled.

The “Add a tool” dialog: a “Search tools…” field and the Platform list of tools, each with a description and tags such as “Side effects”, “Approval by policy”, “Read-only” and a classification ceiling, with an “Add” button per tool.

The Tools tab with one tool bound: “Project search — Search the current Project’s pinned sources, attachments and threads. Returns ranked passages with refs.”, tagged Read-only, with the buttons Posture and Remove, and “+ Add tool” below. Above it the note that a binding never elevates anyone.

A test chat opened from the agent: the banner “Testing · Trip planner v4 (Draft) — Exit test” at the top, the empty conversation “Ask anything about Weekend trips”, and the composer with the agent chip “@ Trip planner” already attached. The sidebar lists “Test · Trip planner” under the Project.
The same test chat with a question typed in the composer: “We are three adults and a dog, budget 300 euro, next weekend. What do you suggest?”
The Overview after publishing: “Trip planner” with a “Published” pill, “v5”, only “Test in chat” left in the header (Publish is gone), Tools 1, Model “Project default (chat · cheapest qualified)”.

The Agent Studio for “Trip planner”, Overview tab: the header with the name, a “Draft” pill, the purpose line, “v3 · updated …”, the buttons “Test in chat” and “Publish”; the tabs Overview · Instructions · Knowledge · Skills · Tools · Models · Permissions · Versions; the form with Name, Purpose (hint “One line shown in the agent picker.”), and the summary Skills 0 · Tools 1 · Model “Project default (chat · cheapest qualified)” · Governance “Not reviewed”.

The Instructions tab: the “Main instructions” text area with a Role line and five numbered Rules, and the hint “How the agent thinks and decides. Tools and skills are configured on their own tabs — not here.”

The Knowledge tab: the line “What the agent may read. Sources are always filtered by the Project and by your access at run time.”; Sources “All approved Project sources (pinned context)”; the “Graph scope” selector on “Project default” with the hint “Verified Domain facts are oracle/human-gated; Project scope includes proposed claims.”; the “Memory” selector on “Project default”.
The Graph scope selector open with four options: Project default (selected), No graph, Project graph, Verified Domain graph.

The Skills tab: the line “Skills are repeatable methods the agent may follow. Only published, non-blocked skills can be attached.” and a checklist of three published platform skills — Create Flow (/flow), Summarize sources (/summary), Pin to context (/pin) — each with a one-line description; none checked.

The Tools tab: the line “Tools are atomic capabilities. At run time the agent can only use what you, the Project and policy all allow — a binding never elevates anyone.”, one bound tool “Project search” tagged Read-only with the buttons Posture and Remove, and “+ Add tool”.

The Models tab: the line “Describe the intelligence this agent needs. Synapse picks the smallest qualified model at run time — inside the Project policy and your clearance.”; the selectors Model role “Chat — General conversation with context”, Routing strategy “Cheapest qualified — Smallest model that clears the quality floor (default)”, a Quality floor slider at “Blueprint default”, Latency “Blueprint default — Interactive for chat, background for flows”, Tier cap “Any tier — Whatever the Blueprint allows”; the summary “Cheapest qualified · Chat · default quality” and a checked box “Allow fallback to another allowed model”.

The Permissions tab: the line “Upper bounds for this agent. The effective permission is the intersection of user, Project, agent, tool and classification policy.”; “Maximum data classification” on “Inherit from Project” with the hint “Cannot exceed the Project’s classification.”; an empty “Purposes” field with the hint “Comma-separated purpose codes the agent may act under”; and the formula “CanExecute = user ∩ Project ∩ agent grant ∩ tool policy ∩ classification ∩ deployment.”
The Maximum data classification selector open: Inherit from Project (selected), public, confidential, dsk, secret, top_secret.

The Versions tab after publishing: the header now shows the “Published” pill and only “Test in chat”; four rows — “v4 · Published · Published” on top of the three draft versions.

The dialog “What should this skill do, step by step?” with an empty text box and a “Draft skill” button.

The same dialog with the method typed in: “Weekend planning checklist: for each proposal give the dates, the place, travel time from home, cost per person, what to do on Saturday and Sunday, and a plan B for rain. Always propose exactly two options and say which one you recommend and why.”

The Skill Studio right after drafting, Overview tab: a generated name with a “Draft” pill, the description taken from your text, “v0.1.0 · Review pending”, a black button “Review before publishing”, the tabs Overview · Instructions · Input / Output · Examples · Evaluations · Versions, the line “A skill teaches a method. The Instructions tab: a “SKILL.md” text area with the drafted Markdown — a heading, a Goal line from your text, a generic “Procedure” of five numbered steps and an “Output format” section — and the hint “The method, step by step. Portable Markdown — no secrets, no credentials.”

The Instructions tab after rewriting: the procedure now has the six weekend steps (confirm inputs · shortlist places within three hours · dates, place, travel, cost per person, Saturday and Sunday · plan B for rain · check the budget · exactly two options and one recommendation) and the output format; the version counter has increased and Save is disabled.

The Input / Output tab: the line “What the applying agent hands in, and the structured result this method teaches it to produce.”; an empty “Input schema (JSON Schema)” box with the hint “A JSON Schema object with type object. Leave empty for free-form.”; and an “Output schema” box pre-filled with an object schema requiring summary, evidence, risks, confidence and next_steps.

The Examples tab, empty: the line “Worked examples: few-shot material for the agent and regression fixtures for the evaluation suite.”, “No examples yet. Add one input with the output you expect.”, and the fields Title, Input (JSON, optional) and Expected output with an “Add example” button.
